title: New Clark City Marathon 2026 Review: Tarlac's Purpose-Built Sports Hub 42K
seo_title: New Clark City Marathon 2026 Review | Tarlac Philippines
meta_description: New Clark City Marathon 2026: August 16 at New Clark City, Tarlac. Full marathon from Run The North at the Philippines' newest sports complex.
dek: Set for 16 August 2026 at New Clark City in Capas, Tarlac, this Run The North marathon brings a full 42K to the Philippines' newest purpose-built sports hub.
verdict: The New Clark City Marathon brings a full marathon to the Philippines' newest purpose-built sports complex — a government-developed hub in Capas, Tarlac with world-class athletics facilities, wide roads, and a master-planned layout designed for major events. Organised by Run The North, it offers a flat, fast course with modern infrastructure. August in Tarlac is the wet season — expect warm, humid conditions. For runners wanting a marathon at the country's most modern sports venue, this is worth tracking.

sections.heading: New Clark City: The Future of PH Sport
paragraphs: New Clark City is the Philippines' flagship sports development — a purpose-built complex with an athletics stadium, aquatics centre, and wide master-planned roads. [1] Run The North brings regional race-production experience. A flat, modern course with minimal traffic.
